targets.query:
from(bucket: "cisco_mdt")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sys/intf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["switch"] == "${Switch}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["interface"] =~ /^${Port:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["dn"] =~ /^.*\/dbgIf(In|Out)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "octetRate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["adminSt"] == "up")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_time", "_value", "interface", "dn"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with 
      _value: r._value * 8
    }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["switch"] == "${Switch}")

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sys/intf")
  |> keep(columns: ["switch"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "switch")
